description: This Java source file defines the class FineractRequestContextHolder, which manages request-specific attributes within the Fineract application. It handles retrieval and setting of request-scoped data using various context sources like HttpServletRequest and thread-bound contexts, especially for batch requests.

classes.name: FineractRequestContextHolder
classes.description: A component that provides methods to get and set request attributes, considering different contexts such as HTTP requests and batch requests, within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the attribute value for a given key, checking request attributes, batch context, and thread-bound context in order.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the attribute value for a given key with an explicit HttpServletRequest; prioritizes the request object, then batch context, then thread context.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets an attribute value for a given key, in either the request object or thread context.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets an attribute value for a given key, with optional HttpServletRequest; determines where to set based on request presence and batch context.

methods.name: isBatchRequest
methods.description: Checks if the current request is a batch request based on BatchRequestContextHolder.
